Title: Vikram's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vikram - 29 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 56 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Manoj - 66 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Kavita - 35 years, friend
Look: green saree

Places

1. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The office - Day

[Vikram stands in the office. Meenakshi and Manoj stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vikram presses the lift button and waits.]

Vikram (gently): "Yes, all right."

[Vikram checks his watch impatiently.]

Meenakshi: "Okay, Manoj."

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Vikram is asleep in bed in the ward. Meenakshi stands near him.]

Meenakshi: "Vikram, look over here."

[After a long illness Vikram passes away in his hospital bed.]

Meenakshi: "We have to be strong now."
